_: The red lip (vermilion): no hair, no sweat glands, sebaceous glands essentially absent (free Fordyce glands only), very thin stratum corneum with high water loss, capillary loops near the surface (its red is blood). Over orbicularis oris; the whole lip is firmer than the cheek. Kept moist by saliva and licking. SKIN lane 11-07.

structure.src: HEADFACE F8 (US), F9 (histology), F1 (T-table at the lips)

glands.v: no sweat glands, no follicles; sebaceous glands essentially absent (Fordyce in ~80 % of adults); TEWL above the cheek

kinetic.src: not found for the vermilion; skin.body values (DERLER12); the lip's thin SC hydrates fast, so it moves toward 'wet' within seconds of licking (E). Another thin-SC site reads 0.66 vs forearm 0.48 (MOIST W7)

static.src: static taken equal to kinetic (skin friction is reported almost only as dynamic)

friction.counterface: smooth hard probe as skin.body unless stated

tack.v: moist lips stick (lip-to-lip seal, saliva bridges); dry lips are tacky after balm; no number

triboelectric.src: not found; usually moist, so charge leaks (wet skin resistivity ~17 ohm m, GABRIEL96)

thickness_mm.src: thin orthokeratinised epithelium with very thin SC (SRL section 2); 40 um E inside the 63 um maximum (HEADFACE F9)

E_kPa.src: FENG22 OCE forearm incl. stratum corneum (small strain)

poisson.src: near-incompressible soft tissue (FENG22 / LAYERS use 0.5; 0.49 keeps a solver stable)

compressible_to_fraction.src: a stiff thin shell: thins little under contact (E)

thickness_mm.src: HEADFACE F8 upper vermilion 1.06 mm total less the epithelium

E_kPa.src: TAKEMOTO24 upper lip ~45 kPa whole-tissue indentation (one man): applied to the whole stack

poisson.src: near-incompressible soft tissue (FENG22 / LAYERS use 0.5; 0.49 keeps a solver stable)

thickness_mm.src: lip 11-13.5 mm to bone (HEADFACE F1) less mucosa and glands: muscle ~6 mm (E)

E_kPa.src: TAKEMOTO24 upper lip whole tissue ~45 kPa (one subject; ~5-11x the cheek's 4.0-9.9)

poisson.src: near-incompressible soft tissue (FENG22 / LAYERS use 0.5; 0.49 keeps a solver stable)

thickness_mm.src: minor salivary glands and mucosa to the teeth (E)

poisson.src: near-incompressible soft tissue (FENG22 / LAYERS use 0.5; 0.49 keeps a solver stable)

contact_stiffness_kPa_per_mm.src: series stack of compliance_layers: E_eff = T / sum(t_i / E_i) = 31.05 kPa over T 11.04 mm, / T; initial (small-strain) value; each layer stiffens with strain (muscle stiffens with activation (pucker, press) like other muscle (SOFTTISSUE R28-R30))

ramp.src: IPC-style log barrier inside collision_thickness keeps surfaces apart; the tissue's own stiffening (exponential in strain) carries the load beyond it

restitution.src: a soft muscular pad on teeth

response_time_ms.src: QU forearm value; no lip recovery time found

membrane_stiffness_N_m.src: E x t = 45 kPa x 1.0 mm (own: stiffer per thickness than eyelid skin's ~21 N/m)

E_kPa.src: TAKEMOTO24 (one healthy man, compact indentation device)

stretch.v: the vermilion's vertical grooves (sulci labiorum) open when it stretches (smile, pucker); mouth corner moves 16-18 mm in a wide smile

conductivity_W_mK.src: ITIS v5.0 (DOI 10.13099/VIP21000-05-0), live table re-read 11-08: Skin average 0.372 W/mK (SD 0.059, 8 studies, range 0.322-0.498); 0.37 kept

heat_capacity_J_kgK.src: ITIS v5.0 (DOI 10.13099/VIP21000-05-0), live table re-read 11-08: Skin average 3390.5 J/kgK (SD 233, 4 studies, 3150-3662)

density_kg_m3.src: ITIS v5.0 (DOI 10.13099/VIP21000-05-0), live table re-read 11-08: Skin average 1109 kg/m3 (SD 38, n 10, 1100-1125); ICRU44 ~1090: recalled, not re-read

effusivity.src: sqrt(k rho c) from the three ITIS values above, J m-2 K-1 s-1/2 (the 'feels warm/cold' number)

emissivity.src: STEKETEE73 abstract re-read 11-08 (paper paywalled; abstract text via a reproduction): skin 0.98 +/- 0.01, independent of wavelength over the measured 1-14 um; white, black and burnt skin measured (normal = burnt); separate per-pigment values are not given in the abstract

moist.src: a saliva film (n ~1.336, water-like); hydrated thin SC -> wet-skin friction (DERLER12)

chapped.src: flaking SC scales roughen the surface (E)
